_note: Draft, hand-written example only (demo.md, first step 1: a player only, hand-written shot JSON for the six primitives, on the existing Sasebo demo). Not a specification. Added in PR #40 as the worked example for that note; moved here from documents/ and played by demo/src/shot-player.ts (?shots=sasebo). Subjects are resolved to coordinates inside the hosted E024 Sasebo TileJSON bounds (129.7018-129.7595 E, 33.1330-33.1835 N; ?v=20261125b, zoom 13-17). The town look-at is the build centre 129.7198, 33.1790 from documents/datasets.md (sheet 01JE3513, central Sasebo around the station); the bay look-at is the west/harbour side of the same bounds, approximate. The demo's own showing view is #map=16.4/33.1768/129.7215/-30/62. The 'track' shot (added 2026-11-28) follows the centre line of national route 35 as GSI's optimized vector tiles (bvmap, layer RdCL, 国道) give it: 66 points over 1.73 km, chained at junctions by the smallest turn, flown toward the town; no heights in the path, so the terrain gives them. Altitudes are camera heights above ground in metres; the demo already keeps a minimum 15 m clearance (demo/src/camera-clearance.ts). Total runtime about 106 s (six shots; the track's 68 s come from its planned motion, E031, hfu chose 1x on 2026-11-28; `time_scale` fast-forwards it).
